violations.text: At the time of inspection, Pico de Gallo and Mango Salsa were observed being held in an ice bath at 48 and 50 degrees Fahrenheit. Per the PIC, the Pico de Gallo and the Mango Salsa were recently placed into the ice bath from cold refrigeration. At the time of inspection, the ice bath was observed to be insufficient to maintain proper cold holding temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. PIC added more ice/water at the time of inspection. Establishment must monitor the food temperatures to ensure they are staying at 41 DF or less. PIC instructed to use bigger pan if needed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of PIC, breaded fish was placed tightly covered in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep after being prepped. Fish was placed into an ice bath at the time of inspection. Proper cooling methods reviewed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026
The bottom of the 3-bay sink was observed with a small leak and in poor repair. Establishment is to fix leak. New Violation. Correct By: 09/28/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine, scale, and 2 door lowboy gaskets have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

The floor in the dry storage area has an accumulation of soil residue, droppings, and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026

Clear Chowder, which was prepared previous day, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours (Observed at 46-48 degrees Fahrenheit in the walk-in cooler). Based on temperature observed, chowder was voluntarily disposed of at the time of inspection. Proper cooling time and temperature, and strategies were discussed at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2025

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of the person in charge, Clear Chowder was placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Cooling strategies were discussed at the time of inspection... (1) Placing the FOOD in shallow pans (2) Separating the FOOD into smaller or thinner portions (3) Using rapid cooling EQUIPMENT (Freezer, Ice Wands) (4) Stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath (5) Using containers that facilitate heat transfer (6) Adding ice as an ingredient New Violation. Correct By: 09/08/2025
